# Real Invisibility: Sulfur Cube

[![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube)](https://github.com/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube?tab=MIT-1-ov-file#readme)
[![GitHub Actions Workflow Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube/build.yml)](https://github.com/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/KKW557/realinvisibilitysulfurcube/releases/latest)

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/realinvisibilitysulfurcube?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/project/kn72WQ5Y)

An extension plugin for [Real Invisibility](https://github.com/KKW557/realinvisibility) that does not hide the blocks inside the bodies of sulfur cubes.

When `realinvisibility` hiding items in body slot:

```properties
# Hide animals' armors?
body=true
```

The block in Sulfur Cube's body will be hidden,
this plugin will revert to the vanilla behavior.

![Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kn72WQ5Y/images/f5730c53c8b563375f7eec6887a3e0f768c81a9e.gif)
